summary: FingerMotion, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 24, 2026, disclosing a press release containing a letter to shareholders from its CEO, Jolie Kahn. The letter outlines the company's strategic plans to enter North American modular AI and high-performance computing infrastructure, focusing on behind-the-meter power and staged capacity. No specific transaction, deal terms, or special-situation event is announced. The filing is informational, detailing the company's strategic direction and operational focus on its existing China mobile data business. No board recommendation, advisors, or financial terms are mentioned. This is a routine strategic update, not a special-situation event.
